canonical_asset.availability_end_semantics: continuously updated; do not persist the catalog crawl timestamp as the scientific end date
canonical_asset.access_requirement: registered Google Cloud project with Earth Engine access and API enabled

scientific_access_constraints: Each Dynamic World image corresponds to an eligible Sentinel-2 L1C acquisition rather than to an annual land-cover map.
The nine probability bands sum to one; label is the index of the largest estimated probability.
Top-1 label must not be interpreted as field truth or as a universally calibrated correctness probability.
Temporal composites and final class assignments require explicit user-defined processing rules.
Masked clouds and shadows create missing observations that must not be interpreted as absence of a land-cover class.

license.required_attribution: This dataset is produced for the Dynamic World Project by Google in partnership with National Geographic Society and the World Resources Institute.
license.upstream_notice: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2015-present]; Sentinel Data Legal Notice also applies.

citation.title: Dynamic World, Near real-time global 10 m land use land cover mapping

distributions.restriction: must not be represented as hosting the raster assets
visual inspection is not equivalent to reproducible analytical access
Apache-2.0 software licensing must remain separate from CC-BY-4.0 dataset licensing

required_before_curatorial_approval: Verify that normalized distribution records preserve the four distinct roles.
Verify that the canonical asset identifier is stored independently from the catalog page URL.
Verify license, attribution, DOI and Sentinel upstream notice in normalized records.
Verify that access requirements are not described as anonymous direct download.
Verify that continuously updated availability is not frozen to a transient catalog timestamp.
Run the normalized database validator after applying the operational enrichment.

supports: operational ingestion status at check time
